newsitem.title: USA: PLM Intl stake acquired by partnership.
newsitem.headline: PLM Intl stake acquired by partnership.

text.p: PLM International Inc said Friday Steel Partners LP filed a Schedule 13D Thursday with the Securities and Exchange Commission reporting it now owns 646,300 shares, or about seven percent, of PLM International's outstanding common stock and may seek control.

The filing indicated that Steel Partners intends to have future discussions with the company about its business operations and ways to enhance stockholder value, and that Steel Partners may in the future seek to acquire control in a negotiated transaction or otherwise, PLM International said.

The company has achieved nine consecutive quarters of positive results," PLM chief executive Robert Tidball pointed out. "While we are not familiar with the business of Steel Partners, we share their goal of increasing value for all investors and we intend to continue our efforts to build value through our strategic plan and by expanding and diversifying PLM International's revenue sources."
PLM identified Steel Partners as a New York-based investment partnership.
